Bash(git -C c:/xampp/htdocs/drweee-website commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix share code API to accept GUID from query param in production

The /api/share/my-code endpoint was only accepting session-based auth
in production, but the session may not persist properly in all scenarios.
Now it accepts the userGUID from query params \(same as other endpoints
like /api/environmental-impact\), which is validated against Dataverse.

This fixes the issue where "Copy Link" and "Share on LinkedIn" were
generating the fallback environmental-impact.html URL instead of the
certificate URL.
